purpose: Execute the atomic translate-body-to-face operation within the MA-15 boundary: One root-body translation to a supplied planar target face. The current variant translates without rotation or deformation and requires the supplied reference point to project onto both trimmed faces.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires translate-body-to-face and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: reference_face
inputs.description: A current face on the moving body used for the reference point.

inputs.name: target_face
inputs.type: current planar DesignFace on another root body
inputs.description: A distinct current planar target face.

inputs.name: reference_point_mm
inputs.description: Finite point in millimetres that must lie on the trimmed reference face.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Finite nonzero travel direction; normalized by the shared direction helper.

inputs.name: position_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Tolerance for reference-point and target-face projection checks in millimetres.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Tolerance for preserving body volume in cubic millimetres.

preconditions: body is a current closed positive-volume root DesignBody and reference_face belongs to it.
target_face belongs to a different current root body and is planar.
reference_point_mm lies on the trimmed reference face within position_tolerance_mm.
direction is finite and nonzero, is not parallel to the target plane, and reaches the target face in the supplied direction.
position_tolerance_mm and volume_tolerance_mm3 are finite and nonnegative.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {body: reacquired current root DesignBody, delta_mm: number[3], reference_endpoint_mm: number[3]}.

postconditions: The body is translated only when a nonzero travel distance is required.
The translated body is reacquired by expected bounds and volume rather than by command return order.
The reference endpoint projects onto the trimmed target face within position_tolerance_mm and body volume is preserved within volume_tolerance_mm3.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Current root bodies are re-enumerated after Move.Translate and the result is resolved from expected bounds and volume; prior topology references must be reacquired after later mutation.

failure_modes.condition: Body/face ownership, point-on-face, target-planarity, direction, reachability, or tolerance validation fails before translation.
failure_modes.detection: Body/face ownership, point-on-face, target-planarity, direction, reachability, or tolerance validation fails before translation.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: Move.Translate raises or no unique body with the expected bounds and volume is found.
failure_modes.detection: Move.Translate raises or no unique body with the expected bounds and volume is found.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate current root geometry and supply a valid reference point, distinct planar target, finite direction, and nonnegative tolerances; no translation is expected.
Treat the root document as potentially partially mutated, reopen a clean run-owned copy, diagnose projection and target reachability, and rerun.
